why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Anthony Seigler is slot #9 (4.481 expected team runs/game).
Slots #9, #8, #7, #6, #3, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 7 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.010 R/G.
Slot #9 yields 3.81 expected PA/game vs 4.69 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Spray Contact (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.006 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
